runtime.outbound_policy: HTTPS only to the fixed Edge control plane and the allowlisted arXiv/PMC source hosts; no inbound listener

artifact.source_commit_role: reviewed Paper Processor runtime source commit included in the release history
artifact.packaging: Python virtualenv; Docker is not the zhangbot delivery path
artifact.artifact_hash_command: sha256sum backend/paper_processor/__init__.py backend/paper_processor/client.py backend/paper_processor/ingest.py backend/paper_processor/runner.py | sha256sum

secret_boundary.processor_delivery: secure SSH stdin once, then local file mode 0600; never command-line or shell history

singleton_lease.instance_identity: boot-id plus process-id plus random nonce
singleton_lease.session_protocol: short-lived connect session with lease and fencing epoch
singleton_lease.restart_behavior: stop polling, let capabilities expire or cancel the fenced attempt, then reconnect with a new instance/session

health_restart.readiness: Edge connect succeeds and the process enters the bounded poll/renew loop; no public health endpoint is exposed
health_restart.liveness: systemd process liveness plus bounded poll progress; transport failure triggers reconnect
health_restart.restart: systemd Restart=on-failure with bounded five-second delay and startup workspace recovery
health_restart.shutdown: stop polling, finish or cancel the current fenced attempt, and remove the temporary work root

logging.redaction_policy: Allow only stage, safe error code, opaque resource/attempt IDs, counts and sizes; redact tokens, headers, URLs, local paths and stack traces

rollback.operation: revoke Processor capabilities and active sessions, stop the service, restore the previous reviewed current symlink, and preserve D1/R2 metadata
rollback.release_restore: point current to the prior immutable release directory and restart only after read-only verification
